Specification: This module specifies Dijkstra's EWD 840 distributed termination detection algorithm on a ring of N nodes. The system tracks whether each node is active, the color of each node, the position and color of a circulating token, and models both the termination-detection actions and the underlying environment actions such as sending messages and deactivation. The specification checks safety and liveness properties about correct detection of global termination, includes an inductive invariant due to Dijkstra, and uses weak fairness only for the token-handling system actions in the main Spec.
